annotations.title: What to do next for the app

description: What to do next for an app, or for every app: the open items of Apptiller's To do list, best first, as the web app shows them. Splits: To approve (listing edits, App Store drafts, findings with a page or pitch to write, ad proposals), Review replies (reviews without an answer, with any drafted reply), Reach out (threads to join, lists to get onto) and New today (alerts). Each item has its app, kind, title, detail, why it is here, evidence, before and after text, what its action does (where it is written, whether it is public, whether it can be undone), due date, score, and locked: the plan feature its action needs when the account's plan lacks it. Snoozed and done items are left out. unavailable names any part that couldn't be read just now. Read-only: it approves, sends, rejects or marks nothing; each item carries the web app page where that is done.

app.description: App name or id (from apps). Every app when left out.

split.description: approve, reply, outreach or watch (New today). All when left out.
